name: engram-mcp
description: Mount the Engram second brain as an MCP shard: 8 tools (recall, search, list_projects, sync_status, append, create, promote_fact, organize) over a standalone always-on Python service that wraps the Valinor Engram seams in-process. stdio for local Claude Code, http for the LAN (MacBook + Hermes). Path-safe and single-writer serialized server-side.
